description: Upload a reusable reference image into an explicit Mint Project; project_id is required. Prefer source_url here for public direct image URLs. Simple public share pages with og:image, twitter:image, or image_src metadata may also work. You can also pass a public reference URL directly to start_world_generation / start_model_generation as image_url. Use base64_data only when you have local bytes that aren't reachable as a URL. Uploads are fetched with SSRF-safe public URL restrictions, validated against Mint's image size/type gates, stashed to Mint CDN, and returned as an imageUrl that can be reused in start_model_generation.image_url, start_world_generation.image_url, or start_world_generation.source_images.

source_url.description: Public direct image URL. Simple share pages with public image metadata may also work.
